- **At the end of May, colleagues from across the affiliates came together in Buonas for the ICX Forum 2026 to connect, challenge our thinking, and shape the future of customer engagement. We also shared affiliate success stories, exchanged lessons learned, and strengthened partnerships across teams and geographies. A particular highlight for me was the leadership panel discussion I had with Xingchu Liu, Ph.D. and Raffaella Claudia Bondi . We have explored what success looks like across markets and key considerations for the future. Thank you to everyone who contributed their expertise, energy, and ideas. Bringing together diverse perspectives from across the organization made this forum both inspiring and impactful. Most of all, I am incredibly proud of my team. They designed and led a forum that brought together strategic thinking, meaningful dialogue, and genuine connection. Their dedication, creativity, and commitment created an experience that not only advanced our priorities but also strengthened the partnerships that will help us move forward together. - **This week in Budapest, I caught myself pausing a few times. We were together for an extended leadership meeting of our global content and Omnichannel execution organisation (The Lab), and at the same time celebrating 5 years of the Lab. Maybe it’s because I’m still relatively new in my role, but moments like this hit differently. Looking at what has been built over the past five years, I felt a real sense of pride. And at the same time, a bit of weight too. The kind that comes with knowing you now get to help shape what comes next. What stayed with me most wasn’t a specific slide or discussion. It was the people. The conversations with colleagues across roles, the energy in the room, the honesty from our internal and external partners. It gave me a much deeper appreciation of what it really takes to make this work happen. There’s a lot of talent, craft, and commitment behind the scenes. It also made something very clear to me. The next chapter is not just about scaling what we already do well. It’s about continuing to evolve, to stay relevant, and to make sure we are truly creating impact where it matters most. I left feeling grateful for what’s been built, and honestly, quite excited for what’s ahead. Congratulations to all the Lab colleagues and Partners for what you’ve achieved so far and for a memorable 2 days in Budapest. - **New Job!!! Starting a new role isn’t really about arriving somewhere. It is much more about becoming a beginner again. A slightly better-informed beginner, hopefully. But still a beginner. Every corporate transition asks you to move far more than your calendar and your job title. It uproots your routines, your family, your baseline assumptions, and sometimes the version of yourself you had grown comfortable with. That friction is never simple. But it is usually where the real execution edge begins. Throughout my career, I’ve been lucky to take on roles that stretched me. Each one taught me something different: about people, about business, about trust, about myself, and about how much there is always still to learn. With that feeling, I’m very happy to share that I’m joining the #Global Commercialization Excellence team at Roche . What makes this step meaningful to me is not only the role itself, but the people I get to build with. A group of leaders I deeply deeply admire, and a team that has already made the first part of the journey feel exactly as it should: grounded in trust, curiosity, and a shared desire to do good work. The WHAT is exciting. The HOW is where we win.**

- **This week officially marks my first month as a Global Digital Hub – Digital Campaigns Intern at Roche ! :) It’s hard to believe that just four weeks ago I was starting this journey. Since then, every day has been an opportunity to learn, adapt, and grow in such a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Over the past month, I’ve had the chance to support the delivery of global digital campaigns, attend a Leadership Visit, and participate in workshops that have given me a much deeper understanding of how our work creates impact and ultimately, improves people’s lives. What has made this experience even more meaningful is the people. I’ve been fortunate to work alongside incredibly talented professionals who have been generous with their time, knowledge, and encouragement from day one. Their willingness to teach and support has made all the difference as I’ve continued building confidence and taking on more responsibility. I’m grateful for everything I’ve learned in just one month, and I’m excited to continue discovering how I can apply my background in Industrial Design Engineering to Project Management while growing in a global digital environment. A huge thank you to the entire team for the warm welcome, and the continuous support throughout this first month. I’m looking forward to everything that’s still to come.**
